mood: Clinical and calm with a hint of menace: a spotless Aperture test chamber, two portal rings and a polite voice.

shape.borderStyle: 1px bevel (bright top/left, dark bottom/right) like the Source VGUI frame
shape.texture: none (clean panels over a blurred chamber photo)

motifs: already implemented in components/sp-game/source-menu.css (shared with Half-Life 2) via --gui-* variables
buttonStyle: Menu items are letter-spaced light-weight uppercase text that turns white on hover with a small blue ring marker; dialog buttons are slate rectangles with a thin bevel and an orange armed state.
backdrop: A softly blurred test-chamber image with a blue and an orange portal ring glowing at steady brightness at the edges; nothing else moves.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
